english.note: Use this especially when explicitly numbering points in a list or argument.
Use this for “firstly” when presenting points in an ordered list or argument.

examples.english: Firstly, you need to submit all the documents; only then can you apply.
examples.traditional: 第一，你要交齊文件，之後先可以申請。
